title: Long work such as the news digest runs as a background task, so the conversation is never blocked by it
description:
Idea (owner, 2026-10-07). Today the news digest is done inside a cognition turn: the schedule news_digest_morning/evening_default (src/plugins/news/index.ts:764-911, handleDailyDigest) wakes cognition, which reads articles and composes the digest while holding the single cognition slot (pendingCognition); only Motor Cortex runs in the background. A message the owner sends meanwhile waits for the digest to end.

Ouroboros (docs/architecture/06-agent-core.md) separates short direct turns (owner chat, wakes) from durable queued tasks with their own lifecycle and stored results.

Proposal: a cognition turn stays short (decide, answer or delegate); long work becomes a task, a generalized Motor Cortex: durable record, recovery after restart (recoverOnRestart exists), result returned as a signal that a short turn delivers. The digest becomes such a task.

Observable criterion: while a digest is being prepared, a message from the owner is answered within the time of an ordinary turn, and the digest still arrives. Disproved if the answer waits for the digest.

Relations: may retire most of lifemodel-aeg (dialogue-1, a message taken into account at every boundary of a proactive turn); a self-change (lifemodel-n6r) also fits as a task.

Left out: choosing the task runner (internal pipeline vs prime-agent), task priorities, cancellation.

Added 2026-10-08 (owner: 'это должны быть задания'): reminders (one-shot and recurring schedule firings) and Motor Cortex results are tasks too. Today a firing is marked done before its signal is processed and a queued signal is lost on a restart or when another turn is busy or the aggregation picks another signal; a completed Motor Cortex result can be lost the same way (pre-existing on main; an acknowledge-after-processing attempt in lifemodel-ctc was rolled back because the core does not know which signals a turn consumed). As tasks they get a durable record and an outcome, so nothing depends on a signal surviving the in-memory queue. Observable criterion added: a reminder due while a turn is busy, or across a restart, is still delivered once.
